purpose: Teach: 課す/形容/メンツ/熟知/表向き/細々/退会/寄附

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、社員にも厳しい目標を課す方だったぞ
lines.en: When our founder was alive, he set strict targets for the staff — never let them coast.
lines.style: Quiet, measured tempo. Each memory lands with deliberate weight. Slight pause before each point, as if drawing from deep recall. Voice carries gentle authority without harshness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは我が社を一言で形容する言葉を生み出された
lines.en: Yes. Father had a gift for summing up the company in a single phrase — it defined us.
lines.style: Steady, respectful cadence. Slight lean into 「一言」as if retrieving something precious. Warm but formal — the tone of a son speaking about his father's wisdom to another. Not rushed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、お取引先のメンツを大事にされたぞ
lines.en: He understood that a partner's dignity mattered as much as the contract itself.
lines.style: Slower pace. Tender undertone beneath the firmness. Each word deliberate. Trailing slightly on the final phrase, like he's still seeing it clearly. Small, knowing pause before speaking.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは業界全体を熟知された方でした
lines.en: Yes. Father understood the entire industry — its history, its players, its unspoken rules.
lines.style: Thoughtful, measured pace. Quiet pride in the words. No rush. A son recognizing his father's depth. Slight catch of emotion held steady in the voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、表向きと内実の両方を大切にされたぞ
lines.en: He knew that how things looked and how things actually worked both mattered — they had to align.
lines.style: Gentle insistence. Slow, deliberate. Pause between clauses. Voice carries the weight of principle without preaching. Small reflective exhale at the end, satisfied.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは細々とした社員の声に耳を傾けられた
lines.en: Yes. Father listened to the smallest voices in the company — never dismissed them as noise.
lines.style: Warm recognition in the tone. Steady pace. Slight lean into 「耳を傾けられた」 — the listening itself becomes audible. Reverent but not distant. A son understanding his father's character more deeply as he ages.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、お得意様の退会を最少に抑える対応をされたぞ
lines.en: He made sure we didn't lose the clients who believed in us — he treated that loss as a failure of his own.
lines.style: Firm with underlying tenderness. Pace slows on the second half. Slight intensity on 「最少に抑える」— the care behind the strategy. Trails into a quiet determination.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは社会への寄附を惜しまれなかった
lines.en: Yes. Father never hesitated when it came to giving back to society — it was always part of the equation.
lines.style: Clear, grounded conviction. Gentle emphasis on 「惜しまれなかった」 — not boasting, just stating fact with quiet pride. Warm close. Voice settles with the finality of a principle fully lived.
